superseded_record_text.notes: Source-owned unconstrained 62-point unweighted fit, measured to 11.5 GPa and 1000 K. Initial first-cycle stressed-foil observations were anomalous; recovered ambient point is explicitly excluded. No statistical confidence/covariance is specified. Nominal-temperature digitized symbols only support a qualified proxy refit, not the original regression. The source Conclusion quotes 2.7% ambient and 1.2% at 10 GPa expansion from 300 to 1000 K; stored coefficients give 2.294% and 1.026%. Figure 2 supports the stored expansion convention; no coefficient is changed to force the prose values. Two fixed-K0-prime alternatives are withheld for missing V0 and thermal parameters.
